ui.there_is_no_online_account_on_this_de.text: Der er ingen onlinekonto på denne enhed: din landsby gemmes kun her. »Start en ny landsby« nedenfor sletter den; at afinstallere appen eller rydde webstedets data fjerner den helt.

ui.they_are_under_fire_pick_the_smoke_bo.en: They are under fire! Pick the Smoke Bomb, then tap on your warriors.
ui.they_are_under_fire_pick_the_smoke_bo.text: De er under beskydning! Vælg Røgbomben, og tryk så på dine krigere.

ui.they_fight_first_in_your_next_attack_.en: They fight first in your next attack and take no Courtyard space.
ui.they_fight_first_in_your_next_attack_.text: De kæmper først i dit næste angreb og tager ingen plads i gården.

ui.they_go_home_for_good_you_get_back_of.en: They go home for good. You get back {arg1}% of their training cost, as far as your storage allows.
ui.they_go_home_for_good_you_get_back_of.text: De tager hjem for altid. Du får {arg1} % af deres træningspris tilbage, så vidt dit lager rækker.

ui.they_walk_in_by_themselves_after_a_ra.en: {arg1} They walk in by themselves after a raid, or when you dismiss warriors.
ui.they_walk_in_by_themselves_after_a_ra.text: {arg1} De går selv ind efter et togt, eller når du afskediger krigere.

ui.they_will_be_able_to_invite_and_to_st.en: They will be able to invite and to start Gang Wars. You stay in the Gang.
ui.they_will_be_able_to_invite_and_to_st.text: Vedkommende kan så invitere og starte Bandekrige. Du bliver i Banden.

ui.this_browser_can_t_save_your_village_.en: This browser can't save your village: progress is lost when this page closes. Use a normal (not private) window, or copy a save code in Settings.
ui.this_browser_can_t_save_your_village_.text: Denne browser kan ikke gemme din landsby: fremskridt går tabt, når siden lukkes. Brug et normalt (ikke privat) vindue, eller kopier en gemmekode i Indstillinger.

ui.this_browser_may_delete_this_village_.en: This browser may delete this village if you stay away for a while. To keep it: install Kagemura (the browser menu → Install app or Add to Home screen), link a sign-in under Online play, or copy a save code.
ui.this_browser_may_delete_this_village_.text: Denne browser kan slette landsbyen, hvis du er væk et stykke tid. For at beholde den: installer Kagemura (browsermenuen → Installer app eller Føj til startskærm), knyt et login under Onlinespil, eller kopier en gemmekode.

ui.this_browser_may_delete_your_village_.en: This browser may delete your village if you stay away for a week.
ui.this_browser_may_delete_your_village_.text: Denne browser kan slette din landsby, hvis du er væk en uge.

ui.this_browser_mode_cannot_save_your_vi.en: This browser mode cannot save. Your village will be lost when you close the page.
ui.this_browser_mode_cannot_save_your_vi.text: Denne browsertilstand kan ikke gemme. Din landsby går tabt, når du lukker siden.

ui.this_device_could_not_store_your_late.en: This device could not store your latest actions (storage full or blocked). They are being sent to the server now; free some space to keep playing offline safely.
ui.this_device_could_not_store_your_late.text: Denne enhed kunne ikke gemme dine seneste handlinger (lageret er fuldt eller blokeret). De sendes til serveren nu; frigør lidt plads for at spille sikkert offline.

ui.this_device_still_holds_your_online_a.en: This device still holds your online account on
ui.this_device_still_holds_your_online_a.text: Denne enhed har stadig din onlinekonto på

ui.this_device_will_play_the_account_lin.en: This device will play the account linked to that sign-in. If its village is kept on the server, it replaces the village here, which stays as a backup in Settings. Your current online account is not deleted.
ui.this_device_will_play_the_account_lin.text: Denne enhed spiller så den konto, der er knyttet til det login. Hvis kontoens landsby gemmes på serveren, erstatter den landsbyen her, som bliver som sikkerhedskopi i Indstillinger. Din nuværende onlinekonto slettes ikke.

ui.this_is_a_server_for_testing_villages.en: This is a {arg1} server for testing: villages and purchases here are separate from the real game.
ui.this_is_a_server_for_testing_villages.text: Dette er en {arg1}-server til test: landsbyer og køb her er adskilt fra det rigtige spil.

ui.this_is_the_testing_sandbox_a_separat.en: This is the testing sandbox: a separate practice village with online play off. Skipping time moves the sandbox clock ahead for good; your real village is never affected.
ui.this_is_the_testing_sandbox_a_separat.text: Dette er testsandkassen: en separat øvelseslandsby med onlinespil slået fra. Tidsspring flytter sandkassens ur frem for altid; din rigtige landsby påvirkes aldrig.

ui.this_starts_a_new_village_that_is_kep.en: This starts a new village that is kept on the server. The village on this device stays as a backup you can restore in Settings.
ui.this_starts_a_new_village_that_is_kep.text: Dette starter en ny landsby, der gemmes på serveren. Landsbyen på denne enhed bliver som en sikkerhedskopi, du kan gendanne i Indstillinger.

ui.time_skips_and_test_purchases_live_in.en: Time skips and test purchases live in a separate testing sandbox, so they can never change your real village or online play.
ui.time_skips_and_test_purchases_live_in.text: Tidsspring og testkøb findes i en separat testsandkasse, så de aldrig kan ændre din rigtige landsby eller onlinespil.

ui.time_until_everyone_who_fits_in_the_s.en: Time until everyone who fits in the Squad Courtyards has finished
ui.time_until_everyone_who_fits_in_the_s.text: Tid, indtil alle, der er plads til i Troppegårdene, er færdige

ui.train_some_warriors_first_duels_use_y.en: Train some warriors first: duels use your army (none are spent).
ui.train_some_warriors_first_duels_use_y.text: Træn nogle krigere først: dueller bruger din hær (ingen forbruges).

ui.train_some_warriors_then_save_the_mix.en: Train some warriors, then save the mix here to refill it later.
ui.train_some_warriors_then_save_the_mix.text: Træn nogle krigere, og gem blandingen her for at fylde den op senere.

ui.trained_ahead_they_join_your_army_whe.en: Trained ahead. They join your army when the Squad Courtyards have room. Jade can't finish them until then.
ui.trained_ahead_they_join_your_army_whe.text: Trænet på forhånd. De slutter sig til din hær, når Troppegårdene har plads. Jade kan ikke gøre dem færdige før da.

ui.training_opens_as_soon_as_the_work_is.en: Training opens as soon as the work is done.
ui.training_opens_as_soon_as_the_work_is.text: Træningen åbner, så snart arbejdet er færdigt.

ui.two_to_four_friends_against_another_g.en: Two to four friends against another Gang of the same size: 2 hours to prepare, then 22 hours with 2 attacks each. Strike alone, or relay: a relay strike starts from half the damage of your Gang’s last strike on that base (defenders patch up in between). No honor is won or lost; everyone gets a chest.
ui.two_to_four_friends_against_another_g.text: To til fire venner mod en anden Bande af samme størrelse: 2 timer til at forberede sig, derefter 22 timer med 2 angreb hver. Angrib alene eller i stafet: et stafetangreb starter fra halvdelen af skaden fra din Bandes seneste angreb på den base (forsvarerne lapper ind imellem). Der vindes eller tabes ingen ære; alle får en kiste.

ui.until_the_season_ends_20_faster_build.en: Until the season ends: {pct}% faster builds, the {arg1} look and bigger rewards on every tier. Rewards you already earned unlock right away.
ui.until_the_season_ends_20_faster_build.text: Indtil sæsonen slutter: {pct} % hurtigere byggeri, udseendet {arg1} og større belønninger på hvert trin. Belønninger, du allerede har tjent, låses op med det samme.

ui.update_kagemura_from_then_open_it_aga.en: Update Kagemura from {arg1}, then open it again.
ui.update_kagemura_from_then_open_it_aga.text: Opdater Kagemura fra {arg1}, og åbn det så igen.

ui.upgrading_your_clan_keep_to_level_unl.en: Upgrading your Clan Keep to level {arg1} unlocks:
ui.upgrading_your_clan_keep_to_level_unl.text: At opgradere din Klanborg til niveau {arg1} låser op:

ui.village_map_drag_to_look_around_pinch.en: Village map. Drag to look around, pinch or scroll to zoom, tap a building to select it. Every action is also on the buttons around the map.
ui.village_map_drag_to_look_around_pinch.text: Landsbykort. Træk for at se dig omkring, knib eller rul for at zoome, tryk på en bygning for at vælge den. Hver handling findes også på knapperne rundt om kortet.

ui.warriors_need_two_buildings_the_dojo_.en: Warriors need two buildings: the Dojo trains them and the Courtyard houses them.
ui.warriors_need_two_buildings_the_dojo_.text: Krigere kræver to bygninger: Dojoen træner dem, og Gården huser dem.

ui.we_keep_only_an_age_group_on_this_dev.en: We keep only an age group on this device and our server, never your date of birth. Please answer honestly: our support team can correct a mistake.
ui.we_keep_only_an_age_group_on_this_dev.text: Vi gemmer kun en aldersgruppe på denne enhed og vores server, aldrig din fødselsdato. Svar ærligt: vores supportteam kan rette en fejl.

ui.when_the_game_hits_an_error_it_sends_.en: When the game hits an error, it sends the error message, where in the code it happened, the game version and the platform, to help fix it. It does not add your name, Player ID, village or chat, but an error message can sometimes include text the game was working on.
ui.when_the_game_hits_an_error_it_sends_.text: Når spillet støder på en fejl, sender det fejlmeddelelsen, hvor i koden det skete, spilversionen og platformen for at hjælpe med at rette den. Det tilføjer ikke dit navn, spiller-id, din landsby eller chat, men en fejlmeddelelse kan nogle gange indeholde tekst, spillet arbejdede med.

ui.when_the_last_of_this_stack_finishes_.en: When the last of this stack finishes, after everyone ahead of it
ui.when_the_last_of_this_stack_finishes_.text: Når den sidste i denne stak er færdig, efter alle foran den

ui.where_you_live_google_play_confirms_a.en: Where you live, Google Play confirms ages for apps. Open the Play Store app, verify your age there, then come back: online play and purchases unlock once Google Play shares your age group.
ui.where_you_live_google_play_confirms_a.text: Der, hvor du bor, bekræfter Google Play aldre for apps. Åbn Play Butik-appen, bekræft din alder der, og kom så tilbage: onlinespil og køb låses op, når Google Play deler din aldersgruppe.

ui.where_you_live_the_app_store_confirms.en: Where you live, the App Store confirms ages for apps. Confirm your age in your Apple Account settings, then come back.
ui.where_you_live_the_app_store_confirms.text: Der, hvor du bor, bekræfter App Store aldre for apps. Bekræft din alder i indstillingerne for din Apple-konto, og kom så tilbage.

ui.who_can_find_me_by_name_64ffa21978.en: Who can find me by name
ui.who_can_find_me_by_name_64ffa21978.text: Hvem kan finde mig med navn

ui.who_can_find_me_by_name_ed481ead6d.en: Who can find me by name
ui.who_can_find_me_by_name_ed481ead6d.text: Hvem kan finde mig med navn

ui.win_raids_to_earn_honor_lose_it_when_.en: Win raids to earn honor; lose it when your attacks fail or when raiders beat your village. More honor bring tougher opponents with more loot.
ui.win_raids_to_earn_honor_lose_it_when_.text: Vind togter for at tjene ære; du mister den, når dine angreb mislykkes, eller når plyndrere besejrer din landsby. Mere ære giver hårdere modstandere med mere bytte.

ui.you_are_about_to_spend_of_real_money_.en: You are about to spend {arg1} of real money. Make sure a parent or guardian says it's OK.
ui.you_are_about_to_spend_of_real_money_.text: Du er ved at bruge {arg1} i rigtige penge. Sørg for, at en forælder eller værge siger god for det.

ui.you_are_in_the_top_league_8b390ac669.en: You are in the top league!
ui.you_are_in_the_top_league_8b390ac669.text: Du er i den øverste liga!

ui.you_are_number_with_power_3a4362c773.text: Du er nummer {arg1} med {arg2} i styrke.

ui.you_are_playing_on_your_own_opponents.en: You are playing on your own: opponents, raiders and your Alliance are friendly bots (always labelled as computer players). To raid real players and join real Alliances, enter a Kagemura: Ninja Clans server address under Advanced, below.
ui.you_are_playing_on_your_own_opponents.text: Du spiller på egen hånd: modstandere, plyndrere og din Alliance er venlige bots (altid markeret som computerspillere). For at plyndre rigtige spillere og gå med i rigtige Alliancer skal du angive en serveradresse til Kagemura: Ninja Clans under Avanceret nedenfor.

ui.you_can_add_each_other_again_later_01.en: You can add each other again later.
ui.you_can_add_each_other_again_later_01.text: I kan tilføje hinanden igen senere.

ui.you_can_found_or_join_a_gang_again_af.en: You can found or join a Gang again after 24 hours.
ui.you_can_found_or_join_a_gang_again_af.text: Du kan grundlægge eller gå med i en Bande igen efter 24 timer.

ui.you_can_join_another_alliance_straigh.en: You can join another Alliance straight away. Warriors in your Alliance Lodge stay with you.
ui.you_can_join_another_alliance_straigh.text: Du kan gå med i en anden Alliance med det samme. Krigere i din Alliancehal bliver hos dig.

ui.you_can_keep_saved_armies_delete_one_.en: You can keep {arg1} saved armies. Delete one to save this army.
ui.you_can_keep_saved_armies_delete_one_.text: Du kan gemme {arg1} hære. Slet én for at gemme denne hær.

ui.you_finished_the_training_please_ente.en: You finished the training. Please enter your year of birth: it sets the right protections for your age (spending limits, offers, and for online play who can find you and how you chat).
ui.you_finished_the_training_please_ente.text: Du har gennemført træningen. Angiv dit fødselsår: det giver den rette beskyttelse for din alder (forbrugsgrænser, tilbud og, ved onlinespil, hvem der kan finde dig, og hvordan du chatter).

ui.you_have_not_cleared_a_tier_yet_cb231.en: You have not cleared a tier yet.
ui.you_have_not_cleared_a_tier_yet_cb231.text: Du har ikke klaret noget trin endnu.

ui.you_have_the_premium_season_scroll_th.en: You have the premium Season Scroll this season.
ui.you_have_the_premium_season_scroll_th.text: Du har premium-Sæsonrullen i denne sæson.

ui.you_joined_after_this_war_started_che.en: You joined after this war started: cheer your Gang on.
ui.you_joined_after_this_war_started_che.text: Du gik med, efter at krigen begyndte: hep på din Bande.

ui.you_left_a_gang_lately_you_can_found_.en: You left a Gang lately: you can found or join one in {arg1}.
ui.you_left_a_gang_lately_you_can_found_.text: Du har for nylig forladt en Bande: du kan grundlægge eller gå med i en om {arg1}.

ui.you_ll_get_back_of_what_you_paid_5919.en: You'll get back {arg1}% of what you paid.
ui.you_ll_get_back_of_what_you_paid_5919.text: Du får {arg1} % af det, du betalte, tilbage.

ui.you_stop_being_friends_and_neither_of.en: You stop being friends, and neither of you can find or ask the other.
ui.you_stop_being_friends_and_neither_of.text: I holder op med at være venner, og ingen af jer kan finde eller spørge den anden.

ui.your_age_group_can_only_be_made_stric.en: Your age group can only be made stricter here. To correct it, contact support from Settings → Privacy and help.
ui.your_age_group_can_only_be_made_stric.text: Din aldersgruppe kan kun gøres strengere her. Kontakt support via Indstillinger → Privatliv og hjælp for at rette den.

ui.your_alliance_is_matched_with_a_real_.en: Your Alliance is matched with a real Alliance of similar size and strength, or with a band of wild bots when none is free. Only members who were in the Alliance when the raid starts take part.
ui.your_alliance_is_matched_with_a_real_.text: Din Alliance matches med en rigtig Alliance af lignende størrelse og styrke, eller med en gruppe vilde bots, når ingen er ledig. Kun medlemmer, der var med i Alliancen, da togtet begyndte, deltager.

ui.your_clan_keep_is_at_the_highest_leve.en: Your Clan Keep is at the highest level available right now.
ui.your_clan_keep_is_at_the_highest_leve.text: Din Klanborg er på det højeste niveau, der findes lige nu.

ui.your_current_layout_is_now_your_duel_.en: Your current layout is now your duel layout.
ui.your_current_layout_is_now_your_duel_.text: Dit nuværende layout er nu dit duellayout.

ui.your_current_village_on_this_device_w.en: Your current village on this device will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
ui.your_current_village_on_this_device_w.text: Din nuværende landsby på denne enhed bliver slettet. Det kan ikke fortrydes.

ui.your_earlier_village_is_back_the_one_.en: Your earlier village is back. The one you were playing is kept in Settings.
ui.your_earlier_village_is_back_the_one_.text: Din tidligere landsby er tilbage. Den, du spillede, gemmes i Indstillinger.

ui.your_earlier_village_is_safe_f15d817e.text: Din tidligere landsby er i sikkerhed

ui.your_first_raid_tap_attack_when_you_a.en: Your first raid. Tap Attack! when you are ready.
ui.your_first_raid_tap_attack_when_you_a.text: Dit første togt. Tryk på Angrib!, når du er klar.

ui.your_friend_code_always_works_share_i.en: Your friend code always works: share it only with people you want to add.
ui.your_friend_code_always_works_share_i.text: Din vennekode virker altid: del den kun med personer, du vil tilføje.

ui.your_new_village_is_kept_on_the_serve.en: Your new village is kept on the server.
ui.your_new_village_is_kept_on_the_serve.text: Din nye landsby gemmes på serveren.

ui.your_on_was_interrupted_and_has_been_.en: Your {arg1} on {arg2} was interrupted and has been played out: {arg3}★, {arg4}%. See the battle log.
ui.your_on_was_interrupted_and_has_been_.text: Dit {arg1} mod {arg2} blev afbrudt og er spillet færdigt: {arg3}★, {arg4} %. Se kamploggen.

ui.your_online_account_was_deleted_resta.en: Your online account was deleted. Restarting offline…
ui.your_online_account_was_deleted_resta.text: Din onlinekonto er slettet. Genstarter offline…

ui.your_player_name_shared_base_alliance.en: Your player name, shared base, Alliance membership, chat messages and warrior requests are deleted from the server now. Online attacks still waiting for the server become practice results. Online play turns off on this device; your village stays. This cannot be undone.
ui.your_player_name_shared_base_alliance.text: Dit spillernavn, din delte base, dit medlemskab af Alliancen, chatbeskeder og krigeranmodninger slettes fra serveren nu. Onlineangreb, der stadig venter på serveren, bliver til øvelsesresultater. Onlinespil slås fra på denne enhed; din landsby bliver. Det kan ikke fortrydes.

ui.your_player_name_shared_base_alliance.en: Your player name, shared base, Alliance and Gang membership, friends, chat messages and any village kept on {arg1} are deleted from that server now. Online play stays off; your village on this device stays. This cannot be undone.
ui.your_player_name_shared_base_alliance.text: Dit spillernavn, din delte base, dit medlemskab af Alliance og Bande, venner, chatbeskeder og enhver landsby, der gemmes på {arg1}, slettes fra den server nu. Onlinespil forbliver slået fra; din landsby på denne enhed bliver. Det kan ikke fortrydes.

ui.your_purchase_is_here_but_this_device.en: Your purchase is here, but this device could not save it (storage full?). Free some space: it stays open in the store and is delivered again if needed.
ui.your_purchase_is_here_but_this_device.text: Dit køb er kommet, men denne enhed kunne ikke gemme det (lageret fuldt?). Frigør lidt plads: det forbliver åbent i butikken og leveres igen om nødvendigt.

ui.your_remaining_troops_go_back_home_yo.en: Your remaining warriors go back home. You keep any loot you already won.
ui.your_remaining_troops_go_back_home_yo.text: Dine resterende krigere tager hjem. Du beholder det bytte, du allerede har vundet.

ui.your_stars_count_toward_the_alliance_.en: Your stars count toward the Alliance War.

ui.your_training_dojo_trains_faster_than.en: Your Training Dojo trains {arg1}× faster than a level 1 Dojo.
ui.your_training_dojo_trains_faster_than.text: Din Træningsdojo træner {arg1}× hurtigere end en Dojo på niveau 1.

ui.your_village_could_not_be_saved_free_.en: Your village could not be saved ({arg1}). Free some device storage, and copy a save code in Settings to keep it safe.
ui.your_village_could_not_be_saved_free_.text: Din landsby kunne ikke gemmes ({arg1}). Frigør lidt lagerplads på enheden, og kopier en gemmekode i Indstillinger for at beskytte den.

ui.your_village_is_kept_on_the_server_ev.en: Your village is kept on the server: every change to its resources, buildings, army and research is checked there, so it cannot be lost with this device. What you do is sent as you play; while offline it waits and goes when you reconnect.
ui.your_village_is_kept_on_the_server_ev.text: Din landsby gemmes på serveren: hver ændring af dens ressourcer, bygninger, hær og forskning kontrolleres der, så den ikke kan gå tabt med denne enhed. Det, du gør, sendes, mens du spiller; offline venter det og sendes, når du får forbindelse igen.

ui.your_village_is_now_kept_on_the_serve.en: Your village is now kept on the server.
ui.your_village_is_now_kept_on_the_serve.text: Din landsby gemmes nu på serveren.

ui.your_village_is_on_the_server_now_cou.en: Your village is on the server now. {arg1} could not be matched to a purchase we checked, so it is held for review: contact support from Settings. Your old village is kept as a backup.
ui.your_village_is_on_the_server_now_cou.text: Din landsby er på serveren nu. {arg1} kunne ikke matches med et køb, vi har kontrolleret, så det tilbageholdes til gennemgang: kontakt support via Indstillinger. Din gamle landsby gemmes som sikkerhedskopi.

ui.your_village_is_saved_and_your_artisa.en: Your village is saved, and your Artisans keep working while you are away.
ui.your_village_is_saved_and_your_artisa.text: Din landsby er gemt, og dine Håndværkere arbejder videre, mens du er væk.

ui.your_village_moves_to_the_server_as_i.en: Your village moves to the server as it is, if it is a village its Keep could really have. From then on every change is checked there, and you can play it on other devices by linking a sign-in.
ui.your_village_moves_to_the_server_as_i.text: Din landsby flytter til serveren, som den er, hvis det er en landsby, dens Borg virkelig kan have. Derefter kontrolleres hver ændring der, og du kan spille den på andre enheder ved at knytte et login.

ui.your_village_saves_automatically_on_t.en: Your village saves automatically on this device. To move it to another device, copy a save code here and load it there.
ui.your_village_saves_automatically_on_t.text: Din landsby gemmes automatisk på denne enhed. For at flytte den til en anden enhed skal du kopiere en gemmekode her og indlæse den der.

ui.your_village_was_opened_in_another_ta.en: Your village was opened in another tab or window, and only one can save it. Your progress is safe there.
ui.your_village_was_opened_in_another_ta.text: Din landsby blev åbnet i en anden fane eller et andet vindue, og kun ét kan gemme den. Dine fremskridt er sikre der.

ui.your_village_was_saved_by_a_newer_ver.en: Your village was saved by a newer version of Kagemura, so this version cannot open it. It is safe and unchanged.

srv.raid.joined_during.en: You joined during this Alliance War; you can take part from next week.
srv.raid.joined_during.text: Du gik med under denne Alliancekrig; du kan deltage fra næste uge.

srv.raid.attacks_used_long.en: You have used your Alliance War attacks (an attack counts from the moment it is begun).
srv.raid.attacks_used_long.text: Du har brugt dine angreb i Alliancekrigen (et angreb tæller fra det øjeblik, det begynder).

srv.raid.side_used.en: Your Alliance has used all of its war attacks (both sides get the same number).
srv.raid.side_used.text: Din Alliance har brugt alle sine krigsangreb (begge sider får lige mange).

srv.raid.attacks_used.en: You have used your Alliance War attacks.
srv.raid.attacks_used.text: Du har brugt dine angreb i Alliancekrigen.

srv.raid.not_ended.en: That Alliance War has not ended yet.
srv.raid.not_ended.text: Den Alliancekrig er ikke slut endnu.

srv.raid.joined_after.en: You joined your Alliance after that Alliance War started.
srv.raid.joined_after.text: Du gik med i din Alliance, efter at den Alliancekrig var begyndt.

srv.raid.not_paired.en: Your Alliance did not take part in that Alliance War.
srv.raid.not_paired.text: Din Alliance deltog ikke i den Alliancekrig.

srv.raid.chest_min.en: Only members who attacked in that Alliance War get its chest (at least {min}).
srv.raid.chest_min.text: Kun medlemmer, der angreb i den Alliancekrig, får dens kiste (mindst {min}).

srv.duel.friends_only.en: You can only duel your friends.
srv.duel.friends_only.text: Du kan kun duellere mod dine venner.

srv.duel.attacked.en: You already attacked in this challenge.
srv.duel.attacked.text: Du har allerede angrebet i denne udfordring.

srv.duel.layout_keep.en: A duel layout cannot be above your Keep.
srv.duel.layout_keep.text: Et duellayout kan ikke ligge over din Borg.

srv.duel.already.en: You and {name} already have a challenge going.
srv.duel.already.text: Du og {name} har allerede en udfordring i gang.

srv.friend.code_failed.en: Could not make a friend code. Try again.
srv.friend.code_failed.text: Kunne ikke lave en vennekode. Prøv igen.

srv.friend.no_code.en: No player with that friend code.

srv.friend.you_full.en: You have {max} friends, the most you can have. Remove someone first.
srv.friend.you_full.text: Du har {max} venner, det højeste antal. Fjern nogen først.

srv.friend.they_full.en: {name} has as many friends as they can have.
srv.friend.they_full.text: {name} har allerede så mange venner som muligt.

srv.friend.requests_waiting.en: You have many requests waiting. Wait for answers, or take some back.
srv.friend.requests_waiting.text: Du har mange anmodninger, der venter. Vent på svar, eller træk nogle tilbage.

srv.friend.bad_provider.en: provider must be gamecenter or playgames.
srv.friend.bad_provider.text: provider skal være gamecenter eller playgames.

srv.friend.link_first.en: Link {provider} to your account first (Settings → Online play → Sign-ins).
srv.friend.link_first.text: Knyt først {provider} til din konto (Indstillinger → Onlinespil → Logins).

srv.friend.bad_findable.en: findable must be everyone, friends_of_friends or nobody.
srv.friend.bad_findable.text: findable skal være everyone, friends_of_friends eller nobody.

srv.friend.under13_findable.en: Players under 13 can be found by friend code only.
srv.friend.under13_findable.text: Spillere under 13 kan kun findes med vennekode.

srv.report.pick_reason.en: Pick a reason for the report.

srv.report.own_message.en: You cannot report your own message.
srv.report.own_message.text: Du kan ikke indberette din egen besked.

srv.report.self.text: Du kan ikke indberette dig selv.

srv.block.self.text: Du kan ikke blokere dig selv.

srv.block.full.en: You have blocked as many players as you can. Unblock someone first.
srv.block.full.text: Du har blokeret så mange spillere som muligt. Fjern blokeringen af nogen først.

srv.moderation.appeal.en: If you think this was a mistake, contact support from Settings → Privacy and help with your Player ID, and we will look again.
srv.moderation.appeal.text: Tror du, det var en fejl? Kontakt support via Indstillinger → Privatliv og hjælp med dit spiller-id, så kigger vi på det igen.

srv.moderation.appeal_contact.en: If you think this was a mistake, write to {contact} with your Player ID (Settings → Online play → Account) and we will look again.
srv.moderation.appeal_contact.text: Tror du, det var en fejl? Skriv til {contact} med dit spiller-id (Indstillinger → Onlinespil → Konto), så kigger vi på det igen.

srv.moderation.message_removed.en: A moderator removed your chat message.
srv.moderation.message_removed.text: En moderator har fjernet din chatbesked.

srv.moderation.message_removed_quote.en: A moderator removed your chat message ("{quote}").
srv.moderation.message_removed_quote.text: En moderator har fjernet din chatbesked (»{quote}«).

srv.moderation.chat_paused.en: A moderator paused your chat until {until}.
srv.moderation.chat_paused.text: En moderator har sat din chat på pause indtil {until}.

srv.moderation.chat_paused_removed.en: A moderator paused your chat until {until} and removed your message.
srv.moderation.chat_paused_removed.text: En moderator har sat din chat på pause indtil {until} og fjernet din besked.

srv.moderation.chat_paused_removed_quote.en: A moderator paused your chat until {until} and removed your message ("{quote}").
srv.moderation.chat_paused_removed_quote.text: En moderator har sat din chat på pause indtil {until} og fjernet din besked (»{quote}«).

srv.moderation.reviewed_message.en: Thanks, we reviewed your report about a chat message by {name}:
srv.moderation.reviewed_message.text: Tak, vi har gennemgået din indberetning om en chatbesked fra {name}:

srv.moderation.reviewed_player.en: Thanks, we reviewed your report about {name}:
srv.moderation.reviewed_player.text: Tak, vi har gennemgået din indberetning om {name}:

srv.moderation.outcome_none.en: we did not find a rule broken, so nothing was removed. Thank you for helping keep Kagemura friendly.
srv.moderation.outcome_none.text: vi fandt ikke noget regelbrud, så intet blev fjernet. Tak, fordi du hjælper med at holde Kagemura venligt.

srv.moderation.outcome_paused.text: spillerens chat blev sat på pause.

srv.moderation.outcome_paused_removed.en: the player's chat was paused and the message removed.
srv.moderation.outcome_paused_removed.text: spillerens chat blev sat på pause, og beskeden blev fjernet.

srv.moderation.renamed.en: Your name was changed by a moderator because it broke the community rules. Reason: {reason}. You can choose a new name in Settings now.
srv.moderation.renamed.text: En moderator har ændret dit navn, fordi det brød fællesskabsreglerne. Grund: {reason}. Du kan vælge et nyt navn i Indstillinger nu.

srv.moderation.suspended.en: Your account is suspended from online play until {until}. Reason: {reason}.
srv.moderation.suspended.text: Din konto er udelukket fra onlinespil indtil {until}. Grund: {reason}.

srv.moderation.unsuspended.en: The suspension of your account has been lifted.
srv.moderation.unsuspended.text: Suspenderingen af din konto er ophævet.

srv.account.apple_deleted.en: The Apple account linked to this game account was deleted, so Sign in with Apple was removed. This game account will be deleted after a short review. If you still play it, contact support from Settings → Privacy and help.
srv.account.apple_deleted.text: Apple-kontoen, der var knyttet til denne spilkonto, er slettet, så Log ind med Apple er fjernet. Spilkontoen slettes efter en kort gennemgang. Spiller du stadig på den, så kontakt support via Indstillinger → Privatliv og hjælp.

srv.account.consent_withdrawn.en: A parent or guardian withdrew consent for this game in the App Store, so online play is off for this account. To ask about it, contact support from Settings → Privacy and help.
srv.account.consent_withdrawn.text: En forælder eller værge har trukket samtykket til dette spil tilbage i App Store, så onlinespil er slået fra for denne konto. Har du spørgsmål, så kontakt support via Indstillinger → Privatliv og hjælp.

srv.account.enter_id.en: Enter your Player ID (Settings → Online play → Account).

srv.signin.update.en: This sign-in needs a newer version of Kagemura. Update the game and try again.
srv.signin.update.text: Dette login kræver en nyere version af Kagemura. Opdater spillet, og prøv igen.

srv.signin.mismatch.en: The sign-in does not match this request. Try again.
srv.signin.mismatch.text: Loginet passer ikke til denne anmodning. Prøv igen.

srv.signin.used.en: This sign-in was already used or has expired. Try again.
srv.signin.used.text: Dette login er allerede brugt eller udløbet. Prøv igen.

srv.signin.taken.en: That sign-in already belongs to another player. Use "Sign in on this device" to switch to it.
srv.signin.taken.text: Det login tilhører allerede en anden spiller. Brug »Log ind på denne enhed« for at skifte til det.

srv.signin.already_linked.en: You already linked another account from that provider. Unlink it first.
srv.signin.already_linked.text: Du har allerede knyttet en anden konto fra den udbyder. Fjern tilknytningen først.

srv.signin.first.en: Sign in on this device first.
srv.signin.first.text: Log først ind på denne enhed.

srv.signin.only_key.en: This device holds the only key to this account. Link Apple, Google or Game Center first (then you can sign back in), or delete the account.
srv.signin.only_key.text: Denne enhed har den eneste nøgle til kontoen. Knyt først Apple, Google eller Game Center til (så kan du logge ind igen), eller slet kontoen.

srv.signin.apple_off.en: Sign in with Apple is not set up on this server.
srv.signin.apple_off.text: Log ind med Apple er ikke sat op på denne server.

srv.signin.not_linked.en: No player is linked to that account yet. Link it from the device you play on first.
srv.signin.not_linked.text: Ingen spiller er knyttet til den konto endnu. Knyt den først fra den enhed, du spiller på.

srv.complaint.subject.en: Say what the complaint is about (a player name, an Alliance or Gang, a message).
srv.complaint.subject.text: Skriv, hvad klagen handler om (et spillernavn, en Alliance eller Bande, en besked).

srv.complaint.reason.en: Say why it is illegal or harmful (at least a sentence).
srv.complaint.reason.text: Skriv, hvorfor det er ulovligt eller skadeligt (mindst en sætning).

srv.complaint.contact.en: The contact must be an email address (or leave it empty).
srv.complaint.contact.text: Kontakten skal være en e-mailadresse (eller lad feltet stå tomt).

srv.purchase.not_set_up.en: Purchases are not set up on this server yet. Nothing was charged.
srv.purchase.not_set_up.text: Køb er ikke sat op på denne server endnu. Der er ikke trukket noget.

srv.purchase.age_first.en: Please tell us your age group first.
srv.purchase.age_first.text: Fortæl os først, hvilken aldersgruppe du tilhører.

srv.purchase.paused_refunds.en: Purchases are paused on this account after several refunds. Contact support from Settings. Nothing was charged.
srv.purchase.paused_refunds.text: Køb er sat på pause på denne konto efter flere refusioner. Kontakt support via Indstillinger. Der er ikke trukket noget.

srv.purchase.minor_cap.en: Monthly spending limit of ${limit} reached for players under 18. Nothing was charged.
srv.purchase.minor_cap.text: Den månedlige forbrugsgrænse på ${limit} for spillere under 18 er nået. Der er ikke trukket noget.

srv.purchase.over_cap_held.en: This purchase would go past the ${limit} monthly limit for players under 18, so it was not delivered. It stays with the store: it is delivered when next month's limit leaves room, or the store can refund it (Google Play refunds an undelivered purchase within 3 days).
srv.purchase.over_cap_held.text: Dette køb ville gå over månedsgrænsen på ${limit} for spillere under 18, så det blev ikke leveret. Det ligger stadig hos butikken: det leveres, når næste måneds grænse giver plads, eller butikken kan refundere det (Google Play refunderer et ikke-leveret køb inden for 3 dage).

srv.purchase.say_which.en: Say which purchase, and whether it was cancelled or is pending.
srv.purchase.say_which.text: Skriv, hvilket køb det er, og om det blev annulleret eller afventer.

srv.purchase.not_sold.en: The game does not sell that product.

srv.purchase.other_player.en: This purchase belongs to another player.
srv.purchase.other_player.text: Dette køb tilhører en anden spiller.

srv.purchase.test_limited.en: Test purchases are limited on the live server.

srv.purchase.apple_off.en: App Store purchases are not set up on this server.
srv.purchase.apple_off.text: Køb i App Store er ikke sat op på denne server.

srv.purchase.google_off.en: Google Play purchases are not set up on this server.
srv.purchase.google_off.text: Køb i Google Play er ikke sat op på denne server.

srv.import.already.en: Your village is already kept on the server.
srv.import.already.text: Din landsby gemmes allerede på serveren.

srv.import.unreadable.en: That village could not be read: {detail}

srv.import.sandbox.en: This village cannot move to the server: it was played in the testing sandbox (time skips and test purchases).
srv.import.sandbox.text: Denne landsby kan ikke flytte til serveren: den blev spillet i testsandkassen (tidsspring og testkøb).

srv.import.refused.en: This village cannot move to the server: {detail}
srv.import.refused.text: Denne landsby kan ikke flytte til serveren: {detail}

srv.import.too_new.en: A village at Keep {keep} can move to the server once this online account is {days} days old (in {wait, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}). It stays on this device meanwhile: keep playing, and the game tries again each day.
srv.import.too_new.text: En landsby med Borg {keep} kan flytte til serveren, når denne onlinekonto er {days} dage gammel (om {wait, plural, one {# dag} other {# dage}}). Indtil da bliver den på denne enhed: bliv ved med at spille, spillet prøver igen hver dag.
